name: Mustard
overview: Scripture uses the mustard seed to illustrate the kingdom of God and the power of faith. Though the mustard seed is the smallest of all seeds, when sown it grows into the largest of herbs, becoming a tree-like plant that provides shelter for birds, symbolizing the expansive and nurturing nature of God's kingdom (Matthew 13:31-32; Mark 4:30-32). Jesus also teaches that faith as small as a mustard seed can move mountains, emphasizing that even the smallest measure of genuine faith makes the impossible possible (Matthew 17:20).
